notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
- Test Mode added,
It allows you to easily learn each level without any disturbing time limit.
However, you don't get any rewards for it.
- Added the ability to repeat the stage directly from a particular level.

notes.title: Version 1.0b
notes.notes:
Version 1.0b
The time limit has been increased at 4, 6 and 7 level.

notes.title: Version 1.0a
notes.notes:
Version 1.0a
- Added option to change volume,
- Fixed incorrect marking of the object in Level 5,
- Fixed a linguistic bug in Level 9,
- Fixed a chest in Level 10.
